lines.zh: 我这么大一块，游起来很慢。
lines.en: Being this large, I swim very slowly.

lines.zh: 我扇着两侧的鳍往前推。
lines.en: I flap both side fins to push ahead.

lines.zh: 深海的暖水托着我这身重量。
lines.en: Warm deep water carries my heavy body.
A wide turn takes me a long time.
I turn slowly like a big round plate.
I swim along the edge of the layer.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴几乎不摆，只靠鳍。
lines.en: I barely use my tail, mostly my fins.

lines.zh: 水流推我，我懒得顶回去。
lines.en: The current pushes and I do not resist.

lines.zh: 我从深水慢慢升到中层。
lines.en: I climb slowly from deep water to mid.

lines.zh: 我这身子一动就很显眼。
lines.en: My body is very noticeable when I move.

lines.zh: 深温带海洋是我的老路。
lines.en: The deep temperate ocean is my old route.
I cross a trench at a slow pace.

lines.zh: 我游过的地方水会晃一下。
lines.en: The water sways a little where I pass.

lines.zh: 我不赶路，反正没人等我。
lines.en: I am not rushing, nobody waits for me.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转头，去看一群水母。
lines.en: I turn slowly toward a bloom of jellies.

lines.zh: 太阳从水面照下来，很暖。
lines.en: Sunlight comes down warm through the water.

lines.zh: 我上浮的时候，身体是斜的。
lines.en: Rising, my body leans to one side.

lines.zh: 海草划过腹鳍，我没什么感觉。
lines.en: Kelp scrapes my fin; I barely notice.

lines.zh: 我停在水里，像一块石头。
lines.en: I hang in the water like a stone.

lines.zh: 十六点生命让我很踏实。
lines.en: Sixteen points of health make me secure.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，等水母漂进来。
lines.en: I open my mouth for drifting jellyfish.

lines.zh: 我的鳍慢慢摆，只为了不沉。
lines.en: My fins move just enough to stay up.

lines.zh: 深海的暖让我昏昏欲睡。
lines.en: The warmth down here makes me drowsy.

lines.zh: 我身上有几道旧的白痕。
lines.en: A few old white scars cross my body.

lines.zh: 我在水层里慢慢翻了个身。
lines.en: I roll over slowly in the water layer.
A jellyfish glows in the distance.

lines.zh: 我不动的时候最像一块礁。
lines.en: Still, I look most like a reef rock.

lines.zh: 头顶的光很远，照不到我。
lines.en: The light above is far and misses me.

lines.zh: 我把身体侧过来晒太阳。
lines.en: I tilt my body to catch the sun.
Pressure rests steady on my back.
I wait for hunger to come to me.
The water temperature in this layer is perfect.

lines.zh: 你这么小，我差点没看见。
lines.en: You are so small I almost missed you.

lines.zh: 我转过来，整块身子挡住光。
lines.en: I turn and my whole body blocks the light.
You look very light in the water.
I'm this big, so I can only turn slowly.

lines.zh: 我侧着身子浮在深水里。
lines.en: I drift on my side in the deep.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛长在身体两侧。
lines.en: My eyes sit on either side of me.
I float up slowly and watch you.
Are you here to hunt me?

lines.zh: 我这条大影子盖住了你。
lines.en: My big shadow covers you completely.

lines.zh: 你的灯在我身上照出一片白。
lines.en: Your lamp makes a white patch on me.
It hurts, but I am not pushed back.
My thick hide took most of it.
My whole body rocks once.
Sixteen points of health still hold.
I sink away from the next blow.
A little blood mist spreads in the water.
I turn slowly to see who did that.
I can take this much pain.
My fins are still beating steadily.
A few more hits will not push me off.

lines.zh: 那点气味从你手里飘出来。
lines.en: That scent drifts out of your hands.

lines.zh: 是水母的味道吗？我来了。
lines.en: Is that jellyfish smell? I am coming.

lines.zh: 我侧着身子，借水流靠过去。
lines.en: I tilt my body and ride the current toward you.
I hold my mouth open for it to fall in.

lines.zh: 我这么大，靠近要花点时间。
lines.en: Being this big, getting close takes time.
The smell is weak, but I caught it.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转，水都被带动。
lines.en: I circle you and the water turns with me.
Hold still, I am almost within reach.

lines.zh: 这点水母，连我的嘴都填不满。
lines.en: This jellyfish barely fills the edge of my mouth.
The scent fades and I slow down.
I bump you and you slide back.

lines.zh: 我的重量让你推不动我。
lines.en: My weight means you cannot push me.

lines.zh: 我靠过来时水都变了形。
lines.en: The water bends when I lean in.
We collide and only you wobble.

lines.zh: 我撞在岩壁上，岩壁闷响。
lines.en: I hit the rock wall and it thuds.
You get squeezed off to one side.
This body of mine is never knocked aside.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转过身，擦过你的肩。
lines.en: I turn slowly and graze your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我道歉，但我的声音很闷。
lines.en: I apologize, but my voice sounds muffled.
After the bump we go our own ways.

lines.zh: 另一条大影子从深处升上来。
lines.en: Another big shadow rises from the deep.
We swim up side by side, slowly.

lines.zh: 我们两条就能占满一片水。
lines.en: The two of us fill one stretch of water.
I press my side to hers, steady.

lines.zh: 深海的暖流把我们推到一处。
lines.en: The warm deep current pushes us together.
This brood adds at most two more.
She turns a little faster than I do.

lines.zh: 我慢慢绕着她游了一圈。
lines.en: I circle her once at a slow pace.

lines.zh: 分开后我们各占一层水。
lines.en: Afterwards we each take a water layer.

lines.zh: 她的影子叠在我的上面。
lines.en: Her shadow lies across mine.

lines.zh: 沉下来的东西我接住了。
lines.en: I catch what sinks down toward me.

lines.zh: 我用嘴把它顶住慢慢吞。
lines.en: I pin it with my mouth and swallow.

lines.zh: 这块食物在我嘴边打转。
lines.en: This food circles right by my mouth.

lines.zh: 我不动，等它自己飘进来。
lines.en: I stay still and let it drift in.
I also pick up what reaches the bottom.

lines.zh: 我含在嘴里，像含着石子。
lines.en: I hold it like a pebble in my mouth.

lines.zh: 这条水母整只都归我了。
lines.en: This whole jellyfish belongs to me.

lines.zh: 吃完我在水里慢慢转身。
lines.en: After eating I turn slowly in the water.
One easy scrap beats a long chase.

lines.zh: 我嘴里还有一点没咽下。
lines.en: A little is still stuck in my mouth.

lines.zh: 一只水母在那边慢慢漂。
lines.en: A jellyfish is drifting over there.
I see its glowing bell.
It is smaller than me, a single bite.
I turn toward its direction.
I open my mouth and draw water in.
It has not noticed me nearby yet.
I rise slowly beneath it.
This one will feed me for a while.
I fix on that small white glow.
I look at nothing else now.
I close in and the water stirs.
It has sunk a little deeper.
I aim my mouth at its bell.

lines.zh: 我的身体挡住了它的退路。
lines.en: My body blocks the way it could flee.
It has touched my lips.
I close my mouth slowly, unhurried.
It is still drifting inside my mouth.
I move it back toward my throat.
Now it cannot get away.
I stop and begin to swallow.
I swallow it whole in one go.

lines.zh: 我的嘴一下合上，水都挤出来。
lines.en: My mouth shuts and water squeezes out.

lines.zh: 它在我喉咙里还动了一下。
lines.en: It moves once inside my throat.
The whole thing makes almost no sound.
I do not bite hard, I only swallow.

lines.zh: 水母的软在我嘴里散开。
lines.en: The jellyfish's softness spreads in my mouth.
I open my mouth again and wait.
This is not enough to fill me.
I sway my fins slowly to digest it.
After eating I float in place.

lines.zh: 我从深海的暖水里浮出来。
lines.en: I surface from the warm deep water.
Only the two of us showed up this time.

lines.zh: 我一生下来就占了半片水。
lines.en: I took half the water at birth.
Sixteen points of health keep me calm.

lines.zh: 深温带海洋的水包住我。
lines.en: Deep temperate water wraps around me.
I slowly spread the fins on both sides.

lines.zh: 附近有条鲨鱼，我先沉下去。
lines.en: A shark is near, so I sink first.

lines.zh: 我这身子在水里很显眼。
lines.en: This body of mine stands out in water.
From now on this layer belongs to me.
I slowly begin my first stretch of swimming.

lines.zh: 水面的火把这一带烤暖了。
lines.en: Fire at the surface warms this whole area.

lines.zh: 我摔下去，水被砸得炸开。
lines.en: I fall and the water bursts apart.

lines.zh: 我在水里，可也会喘不上气。
lines.en: I live in water, yet I can lose breath.
The blast lifts my whole body up.
An arrow sticks in my thick hide.
Magic knocks around inside my body.

lines.zh: 饿了很久，我浮得越来越低。
lines.en: Starving so long, I float lower and lower.
My huge body flipped right over.

lines.zh: 下面的空让我不敢再沉。
lines.en: The void below stops me from sinking further.
